title: api-gateway: six log-line describers (audit-export :28 and :184, batch :28, notifications :30, platform :508, verification :1067) evaluate Object.getPrototypeOf(err)?.constructor?.name with no try of their own, the shape #1754 fixed at platform.ts:1148
description:
## BLUF

**Six log-line describers in** `services/api-gateway` **evaluate** `Object.getPrototypeOf(err)?.constructor?.name` **(and** `Object.keys(err)`**) with no** `try` **of their own, which is the shape PR #1754 fixed at** `platform.ts:1148`**.** There, a thrown value whose description throws (a throwing `message` getter, a throwing Proxy trap, a revoked Proxy) rejected the handler from inside its own catch and the request got no response. Whether each of the six sites below can hang a request is **not measured**.

Facts only. **No fix is proposed.**

Refs KS-1524, KS-1510, KS-1346. The originate half of the same pattern is filed as its own ticket (title starts "originate: five log-line describers"), because the two services have separate unit suites.

All line numbers read at develop `061c3a4f62d563e723b8cee5fe792b4c27dc3014`. The count is Seat AA 1st's (STATUS 2026-10-27T06:29Z, relayed through Wednesday: 12 lines in 9 files) and gate f's INFO on #1754; each site below is re-read here.

## 1 — The six sites

The expression at each is the same describer: `err instanceof Error ? err.message : typeof err === 'string' ? err : typeof err === 'object' && err !== null ? 'thrown ' + (Object.getPrototypeOf(err)?.constructor?.name ?? 'object') + ' with fields [' + Object.keys(err).join(', ') + ']' : 'thrown ' + typeof err`.

| site | where it sits | what runs after it |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/audit-export.ts:28` | inside the local helper `function fail500(res, context, err)` (`:24`), as the argument of `logger.error(context, {...})` | `res.status(500).json(...)` at `:29` |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/audit-export.ts:184` | directly inside a `catch (err: any)` (`:180`), as the argument of `logger.error('Audit export could not reach the security service ...')` | `res.status(502).json(...)` at `:185` |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/batch.ts:28` | `fail500` helper (`:24`), `logger.error` | `res.status(500).json(...)` at `:29` |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/notifications.ts:30` | `fail500` helper (`:26`), `logger.error` | `res.status(500).json(...)` at `:31` |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/platform.ts:508` | directly inside a `catch (err: unknown)` (`:505`), as the argument of `logger.warn('GET /api/platform/audit-log dropped the platform half', {...})` | the handler continues to serve the `audit_logs` rows (the next comment is at `:511`) |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts:1067` | directly inside a `catch (err)` (`:1065`), as the argument of `log('error', 'Failed to fetch document types', {...})` | `res.status(500).json(...)` at `:1068` |

The helper sites are reached through every `fail500(` call in the file: occurrences of `fail500(` (definition included) are 2 in `audit-export.ts`, 4 in `batch.ts` and 7 in `notifications.ts`.

## 2 — The reference

`Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/platform.ts:1148` is the same expression after #1754 (`d54320361`, KS-1524 (a)): it sits in its own `try`, with `catch { described = 'thrown value that could not be described'; }`, and the log call in another `try`, so the constant 500 is always sent. Gate f drove 26 thrown shapes through that route over HTTP: six that hung on develop answered the constant 500, and the other 22 responses were byte-identical (its verdict, relayed, not re-run here). Gate f's INFO on #1754 names `platform.ts:508` as carrying the same expression "out of this PR's scope, read not run".

Both `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/package.json` and the originate one declare `"express": "^4.18.2"`.

## Not established

* **Whether any of the six can hang a request.** None was driven. Each is in a `catch` or a helper reached from one; what the handler's caller does with a throw from inside it is not read per site.
* Whether `Object.keys(err)` can throw independently of `Object.getPrototypeOf`. Not measured.
* What to do about any of them. Not decided.
* **I ran no suite.**

## Searched

Board, KS team, title + description + comment bodies, `includeArchived: true`, paged to the end. `getPrototypeOf(err)` → **1 hit**, KS-1621 (the describer's constructor-name test arm, not a guard). `constructor?.name` → **1 hit**, KS-1621. `describer` → **4 hits**: KS-1621, KS-1619, KS-1462, KS-1167 (archived). `audit-export.ts:28` → **0 hits**. Related, read by title only: KS-1242 (`authenticateToken` async middleware with no catch), KS-1427 (the `unhandledRejection` posture); I did not read every `describer` hit whole. **Positive control** `KS-1531` → 37 hits. **Zero control:** a token coined for this read and written nowhere → 0 hits.

*Filed by Seat G 25th, 2026-10-27 UTC, on Wednesday's brief.*

nodes.title: KS-1771: six api-gateway log-line describers can no longer take a request down

nodes.body:
**Delivered and gate-verified over HTTP with no database; not observed live.** Moved to Done on Wednesday's ruling (2026-10-28T02:11:22Z), on the KS-1484 precedent.

- **SHA:** develop `8894c7486f82f6eb682fecb879791f53312537b1` (#1767 is in it as `32a3aa401d20`). Kintsugi deployed 2026-10-28 10:07:07 AEDT, demo 2026-10-28 13:00:35 AEDT.
- **Delivered, both boxes.** `api-gateway` image, `thrown value that could not be described`, read in the rollback image, the new image and the running container:

| file | count | control (equal at all three reads) |
|---|---|---|
| `dist/routes/audit-export.js` | 0 / 2 / 2 | `Audit export could not reach the security service` |
| `batch.js` | 0 / 1 / 1 | `Batch certify failed (POST /api/batch/certifications)` |
| `notifications.js` | 0 / 1 / 1 | `Notification list failed (GET /api/notifications)` |
| `platform.js` | 1 / 2 / 2 | `Document lookup failed` |
| `verification.js` | 0 / 1 / 1 | `Failed to fetch document types` |

  - The new api-gateway content fingerprint is byte-identical on kintsugi and demo.
  - Each differing route `.js` maps 1:1 to its source hunks. tsc emits `} catch {` as two lines, so it adds one line per catch.
- **Unchanged from outside, both boxes:** unauthenticated, bodyless GETs on the routes these sites serve read the same status and body sha before rsync, after rsync and after the api-gateway swap:
  - `/api/document-types` 200 `[]`;
  - `/api/notifications`, `/api/admin/audit/export` and `/api/platform/audit-log` 401;
  - the 404 control.
- **Not observed live:** a describer that throws (a message getter, a Proxy trap, a failing logger) cannot be triggered from outside, and nobody tried.
- **Gate evidence:** `0_Brain/reference/2026-10-28_gate-t1b/verdict.md`, GO. 36/36 api-gateway cells answered over loopback. Quoted as the gate's evidence.
- **Open edge, a filing candidate:** gate-t1b's LOW F6 records that other catches which read the thrown value before the constant 500 is sent can still hang. This PR fixed the named sites only.

BLUF: PR 1767 (https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1767, head f293d9b34) guards all six describers with PR 1754's shape. Measured first: at base four sites gave no response, one answered a wrong 500, one handed the throw to the gateway's errorHandler. Fixed: 36 of 36 new cells; api-gateway 124 files / 1212 tests before, 125 / 1248 after, 0 failed.

- Measured at base (five inputs per site: four hostile thrown shapes and a throwing logger). No response, 5 of 5 each: audit-export fail500 (:28), batch fail500 (:28), the platform.ts audit-log catch (:508), the verification.ts document-types catch (:1067). The audit-export 502 catch (:184) answered 500 from the handler's outer catch, not 502. notifications fail500 (:30) handed the throw to the gateway's errorHandler, because its handlers are synchronous. 30 of 36 cells failed and vitest reported 20 unhandled rejections (those four sites times five inputs).
- Fix: PR 1754's shape at each site: describe in its own try (fallback "thrown value that could not be described"), log in another; the line is unchanged for every value that could be described before. platform.ts only at the audit-log catch.
- Each guard has its own cells: 12 mutants (describe guard removed, then log guard removed, at each site). Describe guard removed: the four describe arms 0 of 4 pass. Log guard removed: the logger arm 0 of 1 passes. The control passes in all 12. Each mutant parsed before it ran; each restore was git checkout with sha256 equal to HEAD.
- verification.ts and the open pull request 1756: merge-tree rc 0 against its head 5d42cbd45518 (tree 5ba469814884), checked before the push and again at READY time with the same result; my hunk is 179 lines from its nearest one (limit 10); planted-edit controls on its own lines returned rc 1.
- Docs: both appended in the same commit; section 77 is provisional. Develop gained its own section 77 since, so the PR reads CONFLICTING on those two docs only; the merger renumbers mine to 78 or higher.
- Pre-push hook on this head: 13 of 16 legs ran and nothing failed, but legs 3, 4 and 8 were skipped because the local stack is not up, so it is not a pass. Shell suites 95 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped (ks949, no PostgreSQL here), including html_docs_matrix. Test-type ratchet: api-gateway 27 in the baseline, 0 new.
- Not covered: the stack-dependent suites; what an unhandled rejection does to a running gateway (KS 546); the five matching lines in originate (KS 1772). Measured on Node v26.8.1, which is not an LTS line; the host has no Node 24.

Test Evidence is in the PR body.
